name: wukong-email-template-generator
description: Generate WuKong-branded HTML emails inside a fixed, validated email shell.

interface.shortDescription: Generate HTML emails in the fixed WuKong shell.
interface.longDescription: Creates email-compatible body markup, inserts it into the bundled WuKong email shell, and verifies that exactly one complete HTML deliverable is produced without altering the fixed header or footer.

Generate a WuKong CRM follow-up email from this copy.
